title: Write with related value fields
purpose: Exercise the confirmed Write path with a service-choice tag of 5 and two related context-tagged fields to improve field-interaction coverage.
expected_behavior: The receiver should decode a structurally consistent confirmed Write request with invoke identifier 3, service choice 5, and two length-consistent value-related fields.
constraints_preserved: TPKT total length is 0x0015, matching the complete 21-byte message.
Write is service index 5 in the supplied confirmed-service catalog.
The service payload contains context tags 0x80 and 0x81 with declared lengths matching their values.
Nested length fields match their encoded contents.
issue_safety_notes: No issue evidence is supplied and no historical payload is reproduced; field values are conservative structural analogues rather than vulnerability payloads.
